EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Alan Haber, resident, spoke in opposition to the proposed CA-21, regarding the sale of the Kline's Lot. He urged Council to preserve this property for affordable housing.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Alan Haber - Purchase and Sale Agreement for the Kline’s Lot (CA-21) (in person)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Aidan Sova, resident, spoke in support of C-2 and the proposed Tenant's Bill of Rights ordinance.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Aidan Sova - Tenants Bill of Rights (C-2) (in person)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Mark Madonna, resident, spoke in support of CA-21 and the sale of the Kline's Lot. He stated market rate housing is needed in Ann Arbor, not just affordable housing. He stated market rate housing is a better use of the land than a surface parking lot.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Mark Madonna - Purchase and Sale Agreement for the Kline’s Lot (CA-21) (in person)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Marianne James, representing The Ark, spoke about CA-21 and the impact on The Ark of the sale of the Kline's Lot. She stated the alley needs to be widened and sidewalk access is needed and she has requested these requirements be part of the purchase agreement. She urged Council to delay the vote until these issues are addressed.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Marianne James - Purchase and Sale Agreement for the Kline’s Lot (CA-21) (in person)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Jeff Crockett, resident of the Old Fourth Ward historic district, spoke about the businesses that have vacated downtown in recent years, including many hardware and garden shops. He expressed concern about the sale of the Kline's Lot (CA-21) and its future impact on downtown businesses.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Jeff Crockett - Purchase and Sale Agreement for the Kline’s Lot (CA-21) (in person)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Ralph McKee, resident, spoke in opposition to CA-21 and the sale of the Kline's Lot, stating it goes against previous Council's decision to commit this land to affordable housing.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Ralph McKee - Purchase and Sale Agreement for the Kline’s Lot (CA-21) and Crash Statistics (in person)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Christian Barrett, resident, spoke in support of C-2, the Tenant's Bill of Rights ordinance.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Christian Barrett - Tenants Bill of Rights (C-2) (in person)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Ashley Schafer, Director of the Main Street Area Association, spoke in opposition to CA-21, regarding the sale of the Kline's Lot. She stated their members have many concerns and urged Council to delay a decision until those concerns are addressed.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Ashley Schafer - Purchase and Sale Agreement for the Kline’s Lot (CA-21) (in person)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Ilene Tyler, resident, spoke in opposition to CA-21, regarding the sale of the Kline's Lot. She expressed concern about the impact to historic properties and districts near the proposed site.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Ilene Tyler - Purchase and Sale Agreement for the Kline’s Lot (CA-21) (in person)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Elliott Phillips, resident, spoke in support of C-2, the proposed Tenant's Rights ordinance.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Elliott Phillips - Tenants Bill of Rights (C-2) (in person)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Edward Vielmetti, resident, spoke about CA-1, regarding the construction contract with Inner City Contracting for the West Park Bandshell Demolition project. He urged Council to vote against this project and use the funds for needed repairs on the Border to Border trail. He also expressed concern about the demolition of the bandshell, stating its historic value.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Edward Vielmetti - Construction Contract with Inner City Contracting, LLC for the West Park Bandshell Demolition Project (CA-1) (in person)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Sarah Brabbs, York Township, expressed frustration about the sign-up process for public comment. She urged Council to vote no on CA-21.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Sarah Brabbs - Purchase and Sale Agreement for the Kline’s Lot (CA-21) (in person)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Sheila Rasouli, resident, spoke in support of the Tenants Right to Organize ordinance. She spoke on behalf of the Ann Arbor Tenants Union.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Sheila Rasouli - Tenants Bill of Rights (C-2) (in person)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Kathy Griswold, resident, spoke about CA-6, regarding As Needed Transportation Engineering services. She also spoke about the City's record high pedestrian and vehicle crashes.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Kathy Griswold - Professional Service Agreements As Needed Transportation Engineering and Planning Services (CA-6) and Federal Review (in person)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Jade Lathan, resident, spoke about A2Fix It. She urged Council to hire more qualified crossing guards.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Jade Lathan - Response to Current Construction in Ann Arbor (in person)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Odile Hugonot-Haber, resident, spoke about the primary election outcome.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Odile Hugonot-Haber - Welcome Yousef Rabhi (in person)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Laura George, resident, spoke about construction occurring near her son's preschool, Towsley Preschool. She asked Council and the Administrator to think about existing residents when approving projects.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Laura George - Construction Site Adjacent to Towsley Preschool (in person)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Jeff Kahan, resident and former City employee, spoke about the history of the contract negotiations with AFSCME. He stated the buying power of union wages has declined over the last decade and their members are the City's lowest paid employees.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Jeff Kahan - AFSCME Contract Negotiation (in person)

EventItems.EventItemMatterName: 9/8/26 Resolution to Approve Purchase Agreement for Kline's Lot
EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote:
Councilmember Briggs moved the following amendment, seconded by Councilmember Cornell:

Delete:

1.7(c)(v) Purchaser shall maintain reasonable access through and across the public alley and public access easements serving the Property during construction, including the east-west access easement, except where a temporary interruption is necessary for safety and no reasonable alternative means of access is available.


Replace:

1.7(c)(v) Purchaser shall maintain access through and across the public alley and public access easements serving the Property during construction, including the east-west access easement, except where a temporary interruption is necessary for safety provided a reasonable alternative means of access is available. Purchaser shall work with the City to eliminate or minimize the impact of any utility interruption on other users of those utilities. The terms of Section 1.7(c)(v) shall survive closing.

The amendment was considered friendly by the Body.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Resolution to Approve a Purchase and Sale Agreement for the Kline’s Lot (8 Votes Required)

EventItems.EventItemMatterName: 9/8/26 Resolution to Approve Purchase Agreement for Kline's Lot
EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote:
Councilmember Briggs moved the following amendment, supported by Councilmember Cornell:

Add the following RESOLVED Clause:

RESOLVED, Section 6.5.1 of the Agreement shall be amended to include the following language:

•An express restriction which shall be set forth in the site plan approval for the Project (and set forth in any development agreement) limiting the number of residential units which are available for use as a short-term rental (i.e. rentals of less than 30 days) to no more than ten (10%) percent of the then existing number of residential units in the Project; and

The motion was considered friendly by the Body.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Resolution to Approve a Purchase and Sale Agreement for the Kline’s Lot (8 Votes Required)

EventItems.EventItemMatterName: 9/8/26 Resolution to Approve Purchase Agreement for Kline's Lot
EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote:
Councilmember Briggs moved the following amendment, supported by Councilmember Akmon:

Add the following RESOLVED Clause:

RESOLVED, Section 6.5.1 of the Agreement shall be amended to include the following language:

•The definition of All Electric Project shall include language stating that Purchaser shall work in good faith with commercial tenants to establish all-electric connections for the commercial spaces

The motion was considered friendly by the Body.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Resolution to Approve a Purchase and Sale Agreement for the Kline’s Lot (8 Votes Required)

EventItems.EventItemActionText: A motion was made by Councilmember Cornell, seconded by Councilmember Akmon, that the Resolution be approved as amended. On a voice vote, the Mayor declared the motion carried.
